name: Shiraha Yuki
source:
Likes: Her family
Dislikes: Living a life where others have to take care of her

[url=/c41295]Professor Shiraha's[/url] daughter and [url=/c24584]Riku's[/url] older sister. She has been bedridden for the majority of her life due to an illness. Many years ago she became the first Elfin in an event that gave birth to [url=/c16435]Yuuki[/url].
